    """

    - Output height = input height - 1 (skip first row)
    - Scattered marker: if grid[r][c] == scattered_marker_value, output[r-1][c] = 4
    - All other cells: copy from input[r]
    """
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0])
    
    # Find scattered marker position in input
    scattered_val = None  # value that appears once in "band 0" area
    scattered_pos = None
